objective.text: Use ShouldBeUnique to reject duplicate dispatches while its uniqueness lock is held.

difficulty.rationale: Follow duplicate dispatch rejection while a key is locked and renewed eligibility after completion.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: RebuildIndex implements ShouldQueue and ShouldBeUnique with uniqueId()="catalog". Both dispatches use RebuildIndex::dispatch(), the same cache store and no lock expiry. No worker runs between them. How many payloads are enqueued?

options.text: 2, but the second is automatically deleted only after a worker starts it.
options.rationale: ShouldBeUnique checks the dispatch boundary rather than merely filtering execution after both payloads are queued.
options.misconception: ShouldBeUnique checks the dispatch boundary rather than merely filtering execution after both payloads are queued.

options.rationale: The first pending dispatch acquires the unique lock; the second cannot acquire the same lock and is not enqueued.

options.text: 0 until the first unique lock is explicitly released by application code.
options.rationale: The first dispatch acquires the available lock and queues normally.
options.misconception: The first dispatch acquires the available lock and queues normally.

options.text: 2 because uniqueness applies only to different job classes
options.rationale: The class and unique ID identify the lock; these matching jobs conflict.
options.misconception: The class and unique ID identify the lock; these matching jobs conflict.
